prompt: That big family tent holds (many) bags than our small one.
explanation_ru: В сравнении с than слово many перед существительным во множественном числе меняется на форму more.

prompt: Mei drives (carefully) than the other students in her driving class.
explanation_ru: Глагол drives требует наречия, а наречие на -ly образует сравнительную степень с помощью more — more carefully.

prompt: Does the new washing machine use (little) water than the old one?
explanation_ru: Water — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому в сравнении с than слово little переходит в форму less.

prompt: Everyone at the corner bakery works ___ on Saturdays than on weekdays.
explanation_ru: При сравнении двух периодов с глаголом works короткое наречие hard принимает суффикс -er (harder). Типичные ошибки — more hard и hardlier.

prompt: Guests always sleep more good in the room with the fireplace.
answer: Guests always sleep better in the room with the fireplace.
accepted_answers: Guests always sleep better in the room with the fireplace.
explanation_ru: После глагола sleep нужно наречие, и его сравнительная степень — better, а не more good. Типичная ошибка — использовать прилагательное good с more.

prompt: Which leaking pipe in the house drips (fast) after heavy rain?
explanation_ru: Когда мы выбираем одну трубу среди нескольких в доме, короткое наречие fast ставится в превосходную степень — (the) fastest.

prompt: My partner and I booked the back room at a small guest house. We heard (little) street noise there than at our hotel in town. I slept (well) than usual and woke up (early) without an alarm.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым noise используется less, с глаголом slept — особая форма better от well, а с woke up — сравнительная степень earlier от early.

prompt: Nobody in our quiz team answered the bonus round (badly) than Ciaran did.
explanation_ru: Наречие badly образует сравнительную степень не по правилу — worse, а союз than подтверждает сравнение.

prompt: We tested six office printers, and this compact model ran ___ of them all.
explanation_ru: Из шести принтеров выделяется один, а глагол ran требует наречия на -ly в превосходной степени — the most smoothly. Типичная ошибка — ставить прилагательное smooth вместо наречия.

prompt: The hero in this novel talks less than his sister. → The hero in this novel doesn't talk …
answer: The hero in this novel doesn't talk as much as his sister.
accepted_answers: The hero in this novel doesn't talk as much as his sister.
The hero in this novel does not talk as much as his sister.
The hero in this novel doesn't talk so much as his sister.
The hero in this novel does not talk so much as his sister.
The hero in this novel doesn't talk as much as his sister does.
The hero in this novel does not talk as much as his sister does.
explanation_ru: Значение «говорит меньше, чем» через отрицание передаётся конструкцией doesn't talk as much as, которая сравнивает действие по объёму.

prompt: Last month our clinic redesigned its online booking form with clearer labels. Patients now complete the form (easily) than before, and receptionists see (few) mistakes each morning. Older visitors also don't spend nearly (much / time) they used to on the website.
explanation_ru: Наречие easily даёт more easily, с исчисляемым mistakes нужно fewer, а после don't spend nearly с неисчисляемым time ставится as much time as.

prompt: Up on the coast, the wind blows (hard) than inland, yet it doesn't rain nearly (often) it does in the hills.
explanation_ru: В первой части перед than требуется сравнительная степень короткого наречия harder, а во второй после doesn't ... nearly используется конструкция as often as.

prompt: The school drama club put brighter lights on the stage and hung thick curtains around the back. Now the cameras film the actors clearly, and almost no outside light enters the hall.
options: The cameras film the actors more clearly now, and fewer light enters the hall.
The cameras film the actors more clearly now, and less light enters the hall.
The cameras film the actors as clearly as before, and less light enters the hall.
The cameras film the actors more clear now, and less light enters the hall.
explanation_ru: Верный вариант сочетает наречие more clearly с глаголом film и слово less перед неисчисляемым существительным light.

prompt: Our editor asked Daria to fit her report onto a single page without losing key facts. She rewrote the opening (briefly) than in her first draft and cut out unnecessary details. In the end, her article used (few) words than anyone else's, yet explained the local dispute (thoroughly) of all six pieces.
explanation_ru: В первых двух пропусках стоит сравнение с than (наречие more briefly и fewer перед исчисляемым words), а в третьем — превосходная степень наречия (the) most thoroughly из шести статей.

prompt: Tomasz admired the lightweight racing bike, yet he bought the heavier model because it rode (smoothly) on rough tracks and lasted (long) without repairs.
explanation_ru: Здесь сравниваются два велосипеда: наречие на -ly smoothly образует форму more smoothly, а короткое наречие long после глагола lasted — форму longer.

prompt: Despite the optimistic forecast, our accountants predicted ___ sales than the marketing team had promised because they expected several autumn setbacks.
explanation_ru: Существительное sales стоит во множественном числе, поэтому в сравнении с than требуется fewer. Типичная ошибка — выбирать less перед исчисляемыми существительными.

prompt: Moving into the temporary office took longer than we had expected, yet staff members arrive with fewer complaints than they did at the old building.
answer: Moving into the temporary office took longer than we had expected, yet staff members arrive with fewer complaints than they did at the old building.
accepted_answers: Moving into the temporary office took longer than we had expected, yet staff members arrive with fewer complaints than they did at the old building.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: сравнительная степень наречия longer и слово fewer перед исчисляемым complaints употреблены правильно.

prompt: Chidi bought a portable scanner for his site visits around Manchester. It supports (many) file types than his old office machine and fits neatly into his bag. Unfortunately, its battery doesn't last nearly (long) the manual promised, and it reads faint ink (badly) than a desktop model.
explanation_ru: Перед исчисляемым file types в сравнении нужно more, после doesn't last nearly — конструкция as long as, а для badly требуется неправильная форма worse.
